review.note: starts a read-only reviewer; it runs nothing under heavy, so it is never measured

node-tests.note: starts a writer that runs Node tests only (heavy --measure node-tests npm test): never below the fallback

python-tests.note: starts a writer that runs Python tests only: never below the fallback

test-run.note: right before exactly the command run as heavy --measure test-run ...

gradle-build.note: right before heavy --measure gradle-build ./gradlew ...; never below 2048
